title: Call centre with staggered weekday shifts

unsupported.quote: We also need at least one Spanish speaker on every weekday shift.
unsupported.reason: The catalog has no 'at least one of the assigned resources has an attribute' rule: requires_attribute applies to every assignment, so it would demand that all agents on the shift speak Spanish.

notes: Early, mid and late weekday shifts overlap pairwise, so no_overlap is stated and binding. The reference score -10 is optimal: Jamal gets all five early shifts and no other soft rule is violated. Disruption: Sofia is ill on Wednesday 9 December; a feasible re-plan exists (hard 0).
